finding: CoreScale is also an exterior-sizing parameter; tip-only attribution is not isolated.
action: No mesh-law or interpretation change permitted; see the nonphysical scale probe.

finding: P1 compact reuse accepted a 2-mm seed for a 4-mm request because it checked only pass and scale=2.
action: Validate absolute core/radius fingerprints, exterior controls, source mesh, increment, and frozen physical data before reuse.

finding: Full field checkpoints could reuse another material/load/physical configuration or changed T6 ordering/coordinates while T3 still matched.
action: Compare saved material/C and full T6 geometry with the same existing coordinate tolerance.

finding: Compact accepted-result promotion checked path and 11316 elements, but not its exterior/physical source identity.
action: New result metadata records exterior/physics; legacy compacts require source candidate/field evidence.

finding: CoreScale=2 compact promotion/hydration was rejected by the unconditional reference EDI count 11316.
action: Dispatch the existing fingerprint: 11316 for scale 1, 2976 for scale 2; do not permit arbitrary counts.

finding: State row names and declared schema were stored but not validated before positional history parsing.
action: Reject unsupported declared schemas and reordered/renamed columns before geometry/solve work.

finding: NaN family numbers could compare as equal because abs(NaN-x)>tol is false.
action: Reject nonfinite scalar family/core identity values; tolerance values unchanged.

finding: The 4/2/1 publication loader trusted CSV names/lengths without checking the advertised M1+2h0 family or its authoritative summary.
action: Require study/family provenance, unambiguous grids, vertex agreement and summary concordance.

finding: M1/reference and 2h0/reference comparison paired equal segment indices without confirming equal increments.
action: Reject mismatched/nonuniform increments using the existing driver geometry tolerance.

finding: Missing explicitly requested M1 history could silently return canonical committed panels instead of the requested experiment.
action: Canonical fallback retained only for canonical default requests.

finding: An integer target shorter than two increments could reach P1 work before MaxSegments rejected it.
action: Reject the unsupported target before reading/building/saving/solving.

finding: Older fully embedded State histories lack a frozen physical signature; their rows remain a trusted atomic archive, not independently requalified evidence.
action: New states are keyed; do not silently manufacture missing historical provenance.

finding: Metadata-free historical candidates are inferred to be reference exterior/core=1 when reference controls are requested.
action: Legacy compatibility assumption remains explicit. Known source archives are required for legacy compact promotion.

finding: Shared output names can overwrite candidate/qualification files before an incompatible field checkpoint is rejected.
action: Use one isolated directory per increment/core/exterior/frozen source. This audit does not redesign archive transactions.

finding: Direct generic runs keep the accepted reference 4-mm P1 SIF defaults even if increment/core controls are changed.
action: Use an independently qualified/solved seed. Named sensitivity drivers supply their own P1; the generic API cannot infer one.

finding: An absolute calibration transitionLength_m overrides the dimensionless transition option; summary transition fields describe the nominal design.
action: Named M1 protocol overrides slopes only. Custom callers must inspect effective calibration, not only requested ratios.

finding: 92 mm is a default target, not a hidden segment count: N=target/increment with explicit divisibility.
action: 4/2/1 mm gives 23/46/92 segments. Nondivisible targets fail; no shortening or floor conversion.

finding: Accepted Stage-I geometry/material/load/frame stay unchanged; only the in-memory reserved Stage-II increment changes.
action: Full R0 restores bitwise after resetting that one summary cell in the tests.

finding: Historical C.a0=4 mm does not leak into the active P1 carrier: A0Override explicitly forwards the selected reservation.
action: Do not mutate accepted C merely to remove a seemingly stale literal.

finding: Tip size, annulus and core radii use the selected increment; CoreScale changes tip size, not physical core/EDI radii.
action: Coarse 1/2/4-mm core element and COD sampling invariance verified without a PDE/physical solve.

finding: 4/2/1 runs intentionally couple increment and absolute core/exterior mesh scales; they are not fixed-absolute-mesh experiments.
action: Keep this existing interpretation; compare the same dimensionless coarse family.

finding: Source-carrier Hmin/Hmax/Hgrad, mouth width, and physical hole polygon are inherited absolute quantities, not globally rescaled with Delta a.
action: Core/exterior laws scale; the full plate/carrier/boundary seed problem is not a homothetic mesh family.

finding: Qualified fingerprints are duplicated in qualifier, P1 solver, tip solver, study guards and tests.
action: Current values agree. A new qualified family requires coordinated updates, not replacement of only one count.

finding: CoreScale API limits are explicit: propagation supports 1/2; fixed-geometry qualifier/solver also support 0.5; display-only scale 4 is not physically admitted.
action: No silent fallback to scale 1. Do not treat visualization H2 as a physically qualified propagation level.

finding: H2 names mean scale 4 in mesh-level illustration, but h/2 refinement documentation uses another naming convention.
action: Use numeric CoreScale and hTip, not level names, as identity.

finding: MeshFamilyLabel and output-directory tags are display/organization labels; the generic default can still say reference for nonreference numerical controls.
action: Compatibility uses numerical controls, not labels. Do not infer provenance from filenames.

finding: P17/P21/P22/P23, 23 rows and 92 mm in canonical paper generators are deliberately tied to the audited 4-mm reference snapshot.
action: Snapshot guards must not be weakened to accept 2/1-mm histories. These are not generic comparison tools.

finding: Fixed-geometry diagnostics pin reference indices 17/22 and 4*k lengths; custom source files are not a generic physical-length selector.
action: For another increment derive the desired physical length/event from that history. Do not reuse these reference-index defaults.

finding: The 4/2/1 workflow matches common physical lengths rather than equal segment indices and does not interpolate paths.
action: Intersection uses absolute 1e-10 mm; nearest-row check retains 1e-8 mm. Ambiguous duplicate grids now reject.

finding: The partial-level publication path uses 4/2 data until both 1-mm CSVs exist; a live atomic state is not treated as an exported complete study.
action: Two- and three-level branches tested with explicit synthetic fixtures; no physical results fabricated.

finding: Resume is continuation, not an idempotent completed-run load: default Resume=true rejects an already completed unchanged target.
action: No silent extra solve occurs. Changing this continuation contract is outside the mechanical audit fixes.

finding: Assembly depends on a BN_local helper resolved from MATLAB path outside this checkout.
action: Record/pin MATLAB/PDE/runtime/path dependencies. No dependency or solver implementation changed here.

finding: Canonical benchmark/staged reference fingerprints are explicitly reference-only, with an alternative-candidate branch for other qualified families.
action: Do not use reference benchmark/regression entry points as generic increment tests.

finding: Reference manuscript availability wording is not synchronized with the investigator-local exported 4/2-mm comparison.
action: Author review must distinguish partial/coupled 4/2 data from a complete or isolated increment study. No manuscript interpretation was edited.

finding: Historical 8-mm audit constants and fixed Stage-I-source hashes are validation/snapshot identities, not production increment substitutions.
action: No historical data were injected into another increment's seed or trajectory by this audit.
